name: GIRDER 格拉德 Titanium road 2025 SRAM Apex 1×12 mechanical
why_interesting: The 1×12 mechanical SRAM Apex XPLR build of GIRDER's titanium road frame, with an Adler Augen carbon crank and 40 mm carbon wheels, at an official ¥16,800.

facts.drivetrain: SRAM Apex XPLR mechanical 1×12; Adler Augen AC3 carbon crankset with CNC 7075 aluminium 50T narrow-wide chainring, SRAM 11-44T cassette, SRAM Apex 12-speed chain; crank length not listed
facts.frame: 700C titanium road frame, internal routing, 12 mm thru-axles front and rear, UDH dropout, blue anodized finish; welded titanium fork with internal routing
facts.frame_material: 3Al-2.5V titanium frame and welded titanium fork; tube butting and wall thickness are not published
facts.frame_construction: Welded titanium frame and fork; anodized finish
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found
facts.bottom_bracket: T47 threaded, P1.0 thread, 86.5 mm shell width, 52×52 mm bearing cups
facts.wheels: Adler Augen unpainted Golden Eagle carbon wavy-rim wheels, 40 mm, ceramic-bearing hubs, Sapim spokes
facts.tires: Maxxis 700C×28C folding tires fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: Adler Augen integrated carbon handlebar, unpainted 3K finish
facts.geometry: Official chart, stack/reach mm: 440 500/366, 490 514/375, 520 527/380, 540 545/384; chainstay 410 mm, wheelbase 970–980 mm. Every value matches the carbon DASH/BISON chart, so confirm titanium-frame geometry with the seller before relying on it.
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated
